description: This file defines mock classes and utilities for DNS host resolution used in testing, including mock resolvers, rules, and a host resolver factory.

classes.name: MockHostResolverBase
classes.description: Base class for mock DNS host resolvers, providing rule-based resolution and request management.

classes.name: MockHostResolver
classes.description: Mock resolver class that does not use caching, for testing purposes.

classes.name: MockCachingHostResolver
classes.description: Mock resolver class with internal caching, for testing cache behavior.

classes.name: MockHostResolverFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create mock (caching) host resolvers, configurable with rules and caching options.

classes.name: RuleBasedHostResolverProc
classes.description: HostResolverProc implementation that applies rules to map hostnames to IP literals or errors.

classes.name: HangingHostResolver
classes.description: Resolver that simulates a hung DNS request, never completing resolution.

classes.name: ScopedDefaultHostResolverProc
classes.description: Utility to set a default host resolver proc within a scope, restoring previous state on destruction.

methods.name: ParseAddressList
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated list of IPv4 or IPv6 literals into address endpoints.

methods.name: RuleResolver::AddRule
methods.description: Adds a rule to resolve a hostname pattern or rule key to a specific IP or error.

methods.name: RuleResolver::Resolve
methods.description: Resolves a request endpoint based on the rules, returning a result or error.

methods.name: MockHostResolver::LoadIntoCache
methods.description: Preloads cache with specified endpoint and parameters.

methods.name: MockHostResolver::CreateRequest
methods.description: Creates a resolution request for a hostname or host port.

methods.name: MockHostResolver::Resolve
methods.description: Handles resolution requests, either synchronously or asynchronously.
